findings: S2 WARN: 01-PRD.md carries ten must-have features rather than three to six. generate_instruction.md 3 Phase 1 widens the band to six to ten when a companion document is supplied, and a 4,237-line companion is supplied here. The out-of-scope list is present and explicit.

S5 WARN: 04-uiux-brief.md carries the companion's design as words rather than as a hex palette, a pixel type scale and millisecond motion values. That is the settled number rule (generate_instruction.md 4 'The number rule, DECIDED') and source_lint (G51) enforces the word form; the two rules disagree and the newer one governs. Every axis the check lists is present, including the accessibility bar and a mode commitment.

S6 WARN: 05-backend-schema.md states the nickname uniqueness rule as a constraint on a normalised column and the ownership rule as 'the ledger decides writes', rather than naming an index construct. INV9 and G43 forbid the DDL form. Derived-rather-than-stored fields and idempotent seed data are both present and exact enough to assert by value.

A1 WARN: ten H2s, not eleven. `## Build plan` is deliberately absent per generate_instruction.md 2.1, which removed it from the baseline lever set; `## Front-end specification` is the optional unbudgeted section reference/G defines, and it carries the companion's visual detail.

A2 WARN: the framing paragraph chains four steps of one visitor journey (scroll the story, filter the catalogue, read a journal entry, bind an address and land on a citizen page) rather than naming a single action. They are one continuous outcome and the hard part, the boundary around a citizen record, is named separately in the same paragraph.

B1 WARN: the pattern row for `directory-matching` mandates `db` alone and this bundle declares `db` + `storage`. reference/B B.1 states the provider column is the variant-a default and additive slots are the T3 provider axis rather than slot creep. The storage slot carries the companion's passport render pipeline, its media library and its packed catalogue index, all of which are companion content rather than invention.
B3 WARN: two of the three levers are present. `## Build plan` is not emitted at baseline per generate_instruction.md 2.1, the same supersession as A1.

C4 WARN: `## UI/UX notes` states direction and carries no hex, no millisecond and no breakpoint pixel, which is what generate_instruction.md 4 'The number rule, DECIDED' now requires and what this check's own failing-condition list inverts to. Every axis this check enumerates is present as an expectation: palette by role with an exclusivity rule, type by personality and role with tabular figures, shape and density by feel, component states, motion character and reduced-motion, a mode commitment naming which field each route family carries, and the WCAG AA, keyboard and responsive bars. Recorded as WARN rather than PASS because the check still asks for a type scale in sizes, which the number rule forbids for everything except the font family.

C5 WARN: the check asks for the concurrency invariant to be named as a storage-level construct. INV9 and G43 now forbid naming an index or a lock in `## Data model`, so the brief states the observable invariant instead ('Two citizens cannot hold the same normalised nickname at once ... exactly one succeeds and the other is refused'). Derived values and idempotent seeding are both stated as the check requires.

C7 WARN: `## Core features` runs well past the 2,500-char point where run_rubric slices a section, and the joined six pass 9,000. generate_instruction.md 4 states the brief has no length limit and window_lint reports `past-slice` as information rather than a finding. The judged criteria in tests/rubric.json are self-contained and carry their own evaluation_rule, so the sliced tail costs a diagnostic number rather than reward.

Coverage adjudication: every one of the 320 checklist items is cited by a grader. 273 by the pytest provenance sidecar, 34 by browser substeps and 21 by a judged criterion, with no item cited in two channels. coverage_map (G24) and rubric_align_lint (G39) are both green.

Invention sweep: every item carries a `src:` naming a section that exists in instruction.md, and every pinned literal in the checklist round-trips to the brief through the Literals Ledger, which fixture_lint (G6) confirms in both directions.

Trim recorded: an earlier draft carried 459 items, 139 of which no channel graded. They were removed rather than cited falsely, because an item nobody grades reports coverage that does not exist. The detail they carried stays in instruction.md, which is what the agent reads.

320 items across ten section codes, every one carrying a type tag from the seven and a `src:` citation. The coverage ledger clears the obligation-sentence floor in every section.
task.toml carries schema_version 1.4, the P4-db-storage profile, the [delivery] block and the two-author provenance pair, and validate_task.py (G2/G16) is green.

The drawn stack is Litestar on Python 3.12 with Preact and Vite, so the base image is the kit's python:3.12-slim-bookworm plus Node 20, which is what the environment Dockerfile already provides. No second runtime is installed.

One module, tests/test_output.py, carrying 34 functions across the core features, data integrity, authorization and edge-case banners. Every function is named by exactly one workflow substep and every declared slot is observed by name: the storage slot by the bucket and passport document checks, the backend slot by the persisted-row and seeded-record checks.

Thirteen judged criteria authored in solution/trinity/grounding.yaml and rendered into tests/rubric.json by the vendored recompute.py. Each names the surface it grades, defines the product's own words inside evaluation_rule, and carries a yes case and a no case.

RC-15 WARN: thirteen judged criteria against a 320-item checklist means the rubric grades the look-and-feel surface only, which is the channel split INV7 requires. The deterministic surface is graded by the 34 pytest checks and the browser substeps, and coverage_map confirms no item is graded twice.
